description: PnL across a range of hypothetical price moves (in pips, signed by actual price direction, not pre-adjusted for side), for a single forex position size, long or short. Use when user asks "what if price moves X pips in either direction?". Returns: scenarios[] (deltaPips, exitPrice, pnlQuote).

deltasPips.description: Hypothetical price moves in pips, e.g. [-50, 0, 50]

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"

name: workflow.run_forex_scenario
